# Third-party art packs (Freehold)

All packs below are **CC0 1.0** (public domain). Freehold vendors a curated subset under `Assets/ThirdParty/` for offline Hub play.

## Kenney — Nature Kit

- **Source:** https://opengameart.org/content/nature-kit (also https://kenney.nl)
- **License:** CC0 1.0 — see `KenneyNatureKit/LICENSE.txt`
- **Used for:** trees, rocks, stones, grass, logs, campfire ring/logs, water feature pieces
- **Credit (optional):** Kenney.nl

## Quaternius — Ultimate RPG Items Pack

- **Source:** https://opengameart.org/content/low-poly-rpg-pack
- **License:** CC0 1.0 — see `QuaterniusRpgItems/LICENSE.txt`
- **Used for:** axe, dagger (knife), hammer (pickaxe stand-in), potions (bottles), chicken leg / bag (food)
- **Credit (optional):** Quaternius

## Vuena — Free Low-Poly Characters (CC0)

- **Source:** https://github.com/Vuena/free-low-poly-characters-cc0  
  Itch: https://vuena.itch.io/blocky-characters-48 (free subset)
- **License:** CC0 1.0 — see `VuenaBlockyCharacters/LICENSE`
- **Used for:** blocky hero character (`blocky_01_hero.fbx`) with idle/walk/run/jump clips
- Also mirrored under `Assets/Resources/Characters/` for runtime load after Unity import

## Not used / deferred

Paid Asset Store packs and non-redistributable kits are intentionally avoided so this repo stays fully cloneable.
